text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Milton Street, between The Queensway and Dalesford Road. The proposed amendment will deter parking in this location and will improve vehicle movements by maintaining a clear passage for vehicles.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Milton Street, between The Queensway and Dalesford Road.
